{{Quote|Welcome to ''New Coronet'', tarnished jewel of the Trigalis system. The Jedi Archives still identify this&hellip; ''slum'' as a trading post. But there hasn't been any ''legitimate'' business here in decades. Now, it's a pleasure pit for any murderer, pirate, spice fiend, and gambler with ties to Black Sun.|Jedi Master Aayla Secura|<ref name="Obsession 1" />}}
The '''Juris sector''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet]], [[Stend system/Legends|Stend]], and [[Trigalis system/Legends|Trigalis systems]], which lay on the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], as well as the [[Huvveck system/Legends|Huvveck]], [[Tebru system/Legends|Tebru]], and [[Vorusku system/Legends|Vorusku systems]]. The Juris sector [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Vorusku]] and [[Tebru]] served as residences for [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kina Ha]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] inventor and [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Toria Tell]], respectively.

Following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents uncovered the criminal activities of the Vorusku [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Jalla Spree]], while the [[Army of Life]] [[Terrorist/Legends|eco-terrorists]] released [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] of the highly invasive [[clodhopper]]s into the environment on the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] planet [[Stend IV]]. The [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission to Trigalis|dueled]] the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] enforcer [[Xist]] on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] world [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Qeimet [[Star system/Legends|system]] served as the headquarters of Republic [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kintaro]] of the [[Sarin Oversector]].

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] war commenced on the planet [[Stend VI]] that the Empire attempted to stop using a specialized [[Dark Riders|squad]] of [[XR-10 Shadowhawk|speeder bike]]&ndash;mounted [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commandos]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Cressis Linrec|daughter]] of the Imperial [[Linrec|governor]] of the [[Revkinn system/Legends|Revkinn system]] attended an elite [[Unidentified boarding school|boarding school]] in the Juris sector, and in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] was stationed in the Qeimet system when it discovered the [[Hoth/Legends|location]] of the hidden [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I thought you were going to slip into town quietly.''"<br />"''It couldn't be helped, ''Master Secura''. The swamps were more ''dangerous'' than I anticipated.|Jedi Masters Aayla Secura and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Obsession 1" />}}
The Juris sector was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Trailing" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Juris sector bordered the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]] Rimward, and the [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine]] and [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sectors]] [[spinward]], while sharing the [[trailing]] border with the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] and the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]]. Together with the Sanbra and Cadavine sectors, the Juris sector formed the Outer Rim Territories' [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border, neighboring the [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Outer Rim" /> The [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]] passed through the Juris sector's eastern section,<ref name="Five Veils" /> linking the [[Trigalis system/Legends|Trigalis]], [[Stend system/Legends|Stend]], and [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet systems]] to the [[Ninzam system/Legends|Ninzam system]] of the Mid Rim and the [[Lybeya system/Legends|Vergesso system]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of the Bajic sector. Other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the Juris sector included the [[Vorusku system/Legends|Vorusku system]], the [[Tebru system/Legends|Tebru system]], and the [[Huvveck system/Legends|Huvveck system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

[[File:AaylaBorrowedEta2.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The swamp planet Trigalis was a part of the Juris sector.]]
The Stend system<ref name="TEA" /> contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Stend IV]]<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> and [[Stend VI]].<ref name="Wretched">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> The former was a tropical [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world with several [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] on its surface as well as a [[Cloud/Legends|cloudy]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> while the latter had a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate and featured [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], plains, and [[City/Legends|urban]] areas.<ref name="Wretched" /> The planet [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]]<ref name="Obsession 1" /> was located in the system of the same name.<ref name="TEA" /> Its surface was covered with [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]],<ref name="CSWE New Coronet">{{CSWECite|II|373|New Coronet}}</ref> which were home to yellow [[Bird/Legends|birds]] and dark-blue flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="Obsession 1" /> The Vorusku system<ref name="TEA" /> was the site of the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Vorusku]], whose surface featured cliffs as well as a [[Unidentified volcano city|volcano city]].<ref name="Invasion">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]] Rulebook</ref> The Tebru system<ref name="EAOC" /> contained a rocky planet of the [[Tebru|same name]],<ref name="Toria Tell's Droid Journal">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref> while the Huvveck system shared its name with the [[University of Huvveck]].<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref>

==History==
===Waterworld and clodhoppers===
{{RPGseed}}
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[&hellip;]'' I had a vision centuries ago that Kamino would unwittingly create a clone army for the dark side.|Kaminoan Jedi Kina Ha|<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before<ref name="Vorusku date">In ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', [[Kina Ha]] states that, [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the events of the novel, she had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] depicting the creation of a [[Kamino/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]] for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states that Ha had that vision while living on [[Vorusku]], which means she lived on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] centuries before the events of ''Imperial Commando: 501st''.</ref> [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kina Ha]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] future<ref name="501st" /> during her stay on Vorusku.<ref name="GATORW" /> The vision, in which Kaminoan [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] unwittingly created an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]],<ref name="501st" /> haunted the Jedi, causing her to return to Kamino.<ref name="GATORW" /> At some point after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|ended]]<ref name="Invasion" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Vorusku [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Jalla Spree]] began to supply the [[Blue Star Pirates]] with military-grade weaponry. A group of individuals recruited by the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] traveled to Vorusku, where they eventually uncovered Spree's activities.<ref name="Invasion" />
{{Endgame}}

{{RPG|"[[Operation: Clodhopper]]"}}
Shortly after the Invasion of Naboo,<ref name="Operation Clodhopper timeframe">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20010222part1|text=Operation: Clodhopper Part I: Rendezvous at Frundle's|int=Operation: Clodhopper}} is set "just after the events of Episode I," which refers to [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] depicted therein.</ref> the anti-technological [[Terrorist/Legends|eco-terrorist]] group known as the [[Army of Life]] hired a group of individuals to deliver 400 [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] of [[clodhopper]]s, invasive [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known for destroying whole planetary ecosystems, to the largest settlement on Stend IV and release the eggs into the environment. Even though the local [[Colonist/Legends|colonial]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]], led by the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] [[Dree-Tekes]],<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> and a government-tasked group of individuals on a mission to stop the terrorist plot both [[Showdown on Stend IV|attacked]]<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> the Army of Life's [[Majestic Gundark|freighter]] upon landing on Stend IV, the clodhopper eggs were ultimately released into the planet's environment.<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" />
{{Endgame}}

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|This doesn't make any sense&hellip; An army does not sneak into New Coronet without notice&hellip;''"<br />"''Not an army, Lord Xist. Just a general in the Republic Army, seeking ''information'' from New Coronet's most ''reliable'' resource.''"<br />"''A ''Jedi'' seeking only ''death'', I think.|Black Sun enforcer Xist and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Obsession 1" />}}
The area of space surrounding the Qeimet and Trigalis systems was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> When the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were waged between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Qeimet system served as base of operations for the [[Fifteenth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. The Fifteenth [[Sector Army/Legends|Army]] was tasked with defending the territory known as the [[Sarin Oversector]], which included the Trigalis system, against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

[[File:MissiontoTrigalis.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi dueled the Black Sun enforcer Xist on Trigalis.]]
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent<ref name="Trackdown 1">[[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]]</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="CSWE Aayla">{{CSWECite|III|134|Secura, Aayla}}</ref> [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] on a mission to Trigalis<ref name="Obsession 1" /> around the date 19.48 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date Trackdown">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]] to "[[19 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]] (2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], 6 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]])."</ref> [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] also [[Mission to Trigalis|visited]] the planet<ref name="Obsession 1" /> a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later<ref name="Date Obsession">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]] to "2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], 7 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]," which is one month later than the date provided for the events of [[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]].</ref> on a personal mission to learn the whereabouts of the Confederacy [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Kenobi met Secura in the city of [[New Coronet]] and later penetrated the [[Xist's fortress|personal fortress]] of [[Xist]], the local authority of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate. Defeated by the Jedi in a fierce duel,<ref name="Obsession 1" /> the enforcer fed misleading information to Kenobi,<ref name="CSWE Xist">{{CSWECite|III|342-343|Xist}}</ref> who then continued his search off-planet.<ref name="Obsession 1" />

===The Empire ascendant===
{{Quote|On many worlds, 'Ubiqtorate' has come to be the name for the whole of Imperial Intelligence. The name came to light in several COMPNOR scandocs which were accidentally transmitted to a media beamcast in the Qeimat system.|An Imperial Security Bureau report|<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
[[File:SarinOversector.png|thumb|right|220px|The Qeimet system served as headquarters for Moff Kintaro of the Sarin Oversector.]]
By 19 BBY,<ref name="Moff date">The passing of the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], which, according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', established the system of regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]] known as [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], is mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]], the events of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Qeimet served as the headquarters of Republic [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kintaro]] of the Sarin Oversector. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kintaro became the [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Oversector/Legends|Oversector]],<ref name="TEGTW" /> though he relocated his headquarters to [[Talofan]],<ref name="SOTES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> in the Bajic sector,<ref name="EAOC Talofan">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Talofan system/Legends|Talofan system]]</ref> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="SOTE Date">The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' describes events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the Empire, several [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] [[Author/Legends|authored]] by the Imperial [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] were accidentally [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitted]] to a [[Media/Legends|media]] [[beamcast]] located in the Qeimet system. The leaked scandocs revealed to the general public the name of the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], the governing body of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="ISB2" />

Trigalis was located just outside [[Imperial Space|space controlled by the Empire]] by 19 BBY. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by Grand Moff [[Octavian Grant]] passed through the Trigalis system as they [[Five Veils Campaign|pursued]] [[Marath Vooro]], the former [[Customs Vizier]] of the effectively-[[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|disestablished]] Trade Federation, from the planet [[Farstine]] down the Five Veils Route.<ref name="TEGTW" /> Due to a misunderstanding, the [[Zelosian]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Celot Ratua Dil]] was arrested by the local authorities on Trigalis<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> at some point between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TERC Death Star">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], which mentions [[Celot Ratua Dil]]'s arrest on [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]], to between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> The Zelosian was subsequently sentenced to [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet [[Despayre]].<ref name="Death Star" />

===Troubles on Stend VI===
{{RPGseed}}
{{Quote|Despite the best effort of Mannd's forces, Stend VI remains a favorite neutral meeting place for some pirate groups.|A news report by Sektor Newsline 242|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
[[File:StendVI.png|thumb|left|220px|Swoop gang warfare on Stend VI]]
The [[Psychopathy|sociopath]] [[Jeng Seth]] formed the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] known as [[the Skulls]] on Stend VI<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Skulls date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], states that [[the Skulls]] were formed "nearly six [[Standard year/Legends|years]]" ago. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those two battles to the years [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively, thus placing the formation of the Skulls in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] at the latest.</ref> To oppose the Skulls' reign of terror, the gang known as [[the Knights]], led by the idealistic [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Finegan Flint]], was created. The situation eventually escalated into a gang war<ref name="GG9" /> and led to the formation of several other swoop gangs.<ref name="Wretched" />

The [[Razers]] gang succeeded the Skulls when the latter relocated to the Hook Nebula, and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] tried to recruit members of the Knights to their cause<ref name="Wretched" /> at some point between the years 0 ABY and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Knights date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which mentions that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] is interested in recruiting [[the Knights]], is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those two battles to the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively, while establishing the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] as the final event before the beginning of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> In addition, by the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[2 ABY/Legends|37:6:8]], Stend VI had become a neutral meeting place favored by certain [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups.<ref name="GNN" /> To efficiently combat the [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]], the Empire formed the [[Dark Riders]], a specialized [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of elite [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commandos]] mounted on heavily modified [[XR-10 Shadowhawk|speeder bikes]].<ref name="Wretched" />

At some point during the swoop gang warfare on Stend VI, the [[Black Raptor]], the infamous [[XP-2000 prototype speeder bike|swoop]] of the famous [[Swoop racing/Legends|racer]] [[Blizz Pinnix]], mysteriously disappeared. Pinnix put out a very large reward for the swoop's return, which attracted to the planet many individuals eager to look for the lost vehicle, as well as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], a group of individuals, assisted by Pinnix, the Knights gang, and undercover [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officer]] [[Narra Mesyne]], disrupted the operations of the Stend VI-based crimelord [[Kaylo NaKuda]].<ref name="Wretched" />
{{Endgame}}

===An Imperial sector===
{{Quote|I think we've got something, sir. The report is only a fragment from a probe droid in the Hoth system, but it's the best lead we've had.''"<br />"''We have thousands of probe droids searching the galaxy. I want proof, not leads!|Captain Firmus Piett and Admiral Kendal Ozzel, in the Qeimet system|audio=PiettOzzelBestLead-TESB.flac|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], the personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of<ref name="TEGTW" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> rendezvoused<ref name="ESB junior">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> in the Qeimet system<ref name="Qeimet retcon">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' designates the Qeimet [[Star system/Legends|system]] as the location from where [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] begins its travel toward the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at the beginning of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. In ''The Empire Strikes Back'', the origin point of that journey corresponds to the deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] location where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] learns of the location of the [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden Rebel base]] and orders his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to travel to the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].</ref> in 3 ABY.<ref name="3 ABY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] discovery of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Tasked with locating the hidden [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel base]],<ref name="TEGTW" /> the fleet waited in the system to receive any leads on its whereabouts.<ref name="SW39">[[Star Wars (1977) 39|''Star Wars'' (1977) 39]]</ref> While there, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] of the<ref name="FF89">{{FactFile|89|PIE 3-6|Admiral Firmus Piett}}</ref> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the fleet,<ref name="CSWE Executor">{{CSWECite|I|245|''Executor''}}</ref> informed [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] and Vader of a report transmitted by an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] from the supposedly uninhabited [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. The [[Probe droid/Legends|probe's]] findings indicated life readings, which Piett believed signaled the presence of the [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden base]]. Confident that the Empire had indeed discovered the site of the Rebel base, Vader ordered Death Squadron to set course for the Hoth system.<ref name="ESB" /> The fleet then jumped along the Five Veils Route to the [[Farstine system/Legends|Farstine system]], from where it continued its travel to the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. For the upcoming [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attack]] on the Rebel base, [[Juris Sector Forces]] loaned four Star Destroyers to the Death Squadron.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:SW_Executor_01.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Imperial Death Squadron was present in the Qeimet system at the time of its discovery of the Rebel base on Hoth.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an expensive,<ref name="Two">{{WEGCite|story=Two for the Price of One|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref> elite<ref name="CSWE" /> private<ref name="Two" /> [[Unidentified boarding school|boarding school]] was located in the Juris sector.<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Linrec]], the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Revkinn system/Legends|Revkinn system]]<ref name="Two" /> in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> sent his daughter, [[Cressis Linrec|Cressis]], to attend the [[school]].<ref name="CSWE" /> At some point between 0 ABY and 4 ABY,<ref name="GG4 date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Cressis, protesting against her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] decision to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] her off to the Parmel sector's Moff [[Raiss]], conspired to elope with the pirate [[Jondrell Inx]]. To that end, Cressis left her school and boarded incognito a supply [[Starship/Legends|starship]] bound for the Parmel sector's planet [[Kallistas]]. While en route, the girl sent her flight plan to Inx, who proceeded to attack and capture the vessel.<ref name="Two" /> Around the same time, the Juris and [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sectors]] were the only two Outer Rim sectors in which [[House Renliss]], an exclusively-female [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] guild only accepting bounties on male targets, operated.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

By 4 ABY,<ref name="4 ABY date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] transported the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite-encased]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] via the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that Solo had been delivered to Tatooine in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] form by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] traveled along the segment of the Five Veils Route between the Vergesso system and Farstine in his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|starship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], while transporting the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite-encased]] Captain [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. [[9 ABY/Legends|Five years]] later, the Five Veils Route lay within the territories either [[Thrawn campaign|conquered]] by or allied with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]], and the [[Warlord of the Empire|warlord's]] forces [[Siege of Svivren|moved]] from Farstine to the [[Svivren system/Legends|Svivren system]] via the hyperlane that year. The hyperspace route was part of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] ruled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|The Pits is aptly named. Not only is it a swoop racer bar, but it's dirty, dark, and sunk into the ground. If you can't tell a landspeeder from a Star Destroyer, this isn't your kind of place. The crowd is obnoxious, dangerous, and fearless. ''[&hellip;]'' Minor arguments can quickly escalate into massive brawls, especially between rival gangs. If you don't believe me, just take a quick count of all the blast marks in the wall!|Corellian scoundrel Cohden K'Reye, in a treatise describing The Pits|<ref name="Wretched" />}}
Vorusku once served as temporary residence for the Kaminoan Jedi Kina Ha.<ref name="GATORW" /> Following the Invasion of Naboo, the headquarters of the crimelord Jalla Spree were located on Vorusku.<ref name="Invasion" /> [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] before the Galactic Civil War, Stend IV was settled by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colonists from the<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> Mid Rim<ref name="TEA" /> world of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" /> The colony world was at a low level of technology and only maintained a rag-tag colonial militia of limited military experience.<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> One continent on Stend IV was also home to [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] colonists.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] inventor and [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Toria Tell]] maintained a large residence on Tebru<ref name="Toria Tell's Droid Journal" /> by 3 ABY.<ref name="Date note">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}} mentions the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in an excerpt from an [[in-universe]] [[Toria Tell's Droid Journal (scandoc)|scandoc]] published by [[Toria Tell]], implying that she was active in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following that conflict. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref>

[[File:Obsession_1_06.jpg|thumb|left|200px|New Coronet, a famous shadowport on Trigalis]]
At some point long before the Clone Wars, the city of New Coronet was established on Trigalis as a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] post. Over time, the city devolved into a haven for individuals indulging in criminal activities, most of whom were connected to the Black Sun syndicate,<ref name="Obsession 1" /> and the planet Trigalis became a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="TEA" /> Representatives of several [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], were present in New Coronet during Obi-Wan Kenobi's mission to the city during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Obsession 1" /> The population of the Qeimet and Trigalis systems numbered from 10 million to 100 million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Stend VI had a mostly Human population of 2.2 billion. The inhabitants of the Outer Rim world were [[Politics/Legends|governed]] by a representative [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] allied with the Galactic Empire, in which the planet served the role of a manufacturing and processing site. The swoop gangs of Stend VI were responsible for daily skirmishes in the planet's skies. A prominent location on Stend VI was the swoop [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]]. The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] businessman Kaylo NaKuda, who oversaw the [[Standard day/Legends|day]]-to-day operations of The Pits on behalf of the bar's owner, Blizz Pinnix, also ran a criminal outfit based in the adjacent [[Kuda's Compound]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sil Vaturha]], one of the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals forced to work at Kuda's Compound's hidden, underground garages, was probably one of the most technologically-skilled individuals within<ref name="Wretched" /> the Juris sector<ref name="EAOC Stend">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Stend system/Legends|Stend system]]</ref> as well as several of the surrounding sectors.<ref name="Wretched" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GalaxyGuide10.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Juris sector was first mentioned in ''Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters''.]]
The Juris sector was first mentioned in the [[1994]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''. The book was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" /> In [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively established]] the Qeimet system as having appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' later placed Qeimet within the Juris sector, thereby establishing the film as the de facto earliest appearance of the sector.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[September 10]], 2009, the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20110703024008/https://www.starwars.com/vault/books/atlas/news20090910/index.html ''Essential Atlas'' Extra: Outer Rim Sectors]," which placed it in grid squares O-17, P-17, and P-18.<ref name="OuterRimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/atlas/news20090910/index.html|text=''Essential Atlas'' Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a reference book published in [[2008]], placed the Juris sector near the Albanin sector.<ref name="CSWE" /> This placement was contradicted by ''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion, which established that the star systems of the Juris and Albanin sectors respectively lay in grid squares<ref name="EAOC" /> corresponding to the southeastern and eastern quadrant of the Outer Rim Territories per ''The Essential Atlas''.<ref name="TEA" /> "''Essential Atlas'' Extra: Outer Rim Sectors" further depicted the two sectors as lying approximately 30,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] apart.<ref name="Outer Rim" />
